{"id":2053258752,"question_id":3558,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"3 weeks","timestamp":1782980952,"status":14,"status_display":"Time Limit Exceeded","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/2053258752/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Find a Safe Walk Through a Grid","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int n , m;\n    vector<vector<bool>>vis;\n\n    bool byrec(vector<vector<int>>&grid , int health , int i , int j)\n    {\n        if(i >= n or j >= m or i < 0 or j < 0 or vis[i][j]) return false;\n        if(grid[i][j] == 1) health--;\n        if(health < 1) return false;\n\n        if(i == n-1 and j == m-1) return true;\n\n        vis[i][j] = true;\n\n        bool up = byrec(grid , health , i-1 , j);\n        bool down = byrec(grid , health , i+1 , j);\n        bool left = byrec(grid , health , i , j-1);\n        bool right = byrec(grid , health , i , j+1);\n\n        vis[i][j] = false;\n\n        return up or down or left or right;\n    }\n\n    bool findSafeWalk(vector<vector<int>>& grid, int health) {\n        n = grid.size();\n        m = grid[0].size();\n\n        vis.resize(n , vector<bool>(m , false));\n        return byrec(grid , health , 0 , 0);\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"find-a-safe-walk-through-a-grid","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2279}
